scope: Local helper tests and synthetic probes. Saved task validation is read-only. No product commands or remote writes were run.
synthetic_probe_method: Imported existing local test fixtures. Used temporary Git repositories for checkpoint and identity probes. Used in-memory inputs for route and coverage probes. For concurrency, held an exclusive file lock until both checkpoint callers waited at locks_lock_inode_wait, then released it. Tests do not establish historical occurrence.
